groups.sentence: Students ask their instructor about course AI rules and unclear expectations, and check the syllabus, at the start of the course.
Students seek clarification from the instructor about AI policies before starting their work.
Instructors encourage students to ask questions about AI use and explain how and whom to ask when unsure.
Students who are unsure whether an AI use is allowed ask their instructor before using it.
Students who are unsure ask the instructor before submitting their work.
When unsure whether AI use is allowed, students avoid using AI or assume it is not allowed.
Graduate students discuss acceptable AI use with their advisors or committee, and must do so where required.
When unsure, students err on the side of full disclosure of their AI use.
Staff and others who are unsure about AI use consult their supervisor, unit leadership or IT.
Students are welcome to contact the instructor with questions about AI use.
Failing to ask is no excuse, students may have rules clarified, and unclear AI use risks harm.
